subject: Request to Release Escrowed Credit + VAT Evidence for Q4 Adjustment
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@novacentral.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@novacentral.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Escrow hold on Oct invoice

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the call earlier. We noticed a $42,300 charge on the Oct 2026 invoice for a connector ingestion spike that our systems flagged as duplicated ingestion (two runs of the same pipeline). Our AP team has put the amount into escrow while we reconcile. Can you confirm whether Redwood will issue a service credit or a goodwill adjustment?

AP attached the invoice and a short log extract for your ops team. We need any tax/VAT evidence to clear internal controls; without it our payment team can't release the escrowed funds to your account.

Attachments: Novacentral_Invoice_2026-10.pdf, ingestion_log_excerpt.txt

Goal: Looking to resolve before month-end close (Nov 30). Please advise next steps and what evidence you need from us.

Best,
Elena
Elena Morales
Director of Finance, Novacentral
[Attachment: Novacentral_Invoice_2026-10.pdf]
[Attachment: ingestion_log_excerpt.txt]

From: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novacentral.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Escrow hold on Oct invoice

Elena — thanks for flagging and for the log extract. I reviewed this with our billing and infra teams: it looks like there was an automated retry that produced duplicate usage for the connector job between 2026-10-12 02:14 UTC and 2026-10-12 02:20 UTC. We agree this should not be charged twice.

Proposed remediation:
- Redwood will issue a goodwill credit for the duplicated token usage (~$42,300).
- To process the credit and release funds from escrow, our billing team requires a VAT certificate for Novacentral (EU/zero-rate evidence) or confirmation of VAT registration country, and a signed Escrow Release Authorization.

Next steps I can own: I'll loop in Lauren to get the credit issued and provide the DocuSign release. If you can send VAT_certificate_Novacentral.pdf and have your AP sign the attached authorization, we can prioritize this for Nov month-end.

Cc'ing Marissa to keep Customer Success in the loop on operational impact.

I'll follow up with an internal ledger reference and expected timing once Lauren confirms.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
[Attachment: Escrow_Release_Authorization.pdf]

From: Elena Morales <elena@novacentral.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@novacentral.com, Legal Team <legal@novacentral.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Escrow hold on Oct invoice

Jordan,

Thanks — we've attached the VAT certificate and a signed PDF of the Escrow Release Authorization from AP. Legal has a couple of standard redlines on the release wording (non-substantive — jurisdiction and indemnity clause) that they attached as well. If Redwood needs an original signature instead of a signed PDF, let us know.

We appreciate the swift handling; Novacentral is prepared to release the escrow once Redwood confirms the credit and provides the accounting reference. Can you confirm the exact credit amount you'll post and whether it will appear as a separate credit memo or as an adjustment on the next invoice?

Attachments: VAT_certificate_Novacentral.pdf, Escrow_Release_Authorization_signed.pdf, Legal_redlines.pdf

Best,
Elena
Elena Morales
Director of Finance, Novacentral
[Attachment: VAT_certificate_Novacentral.pdf]
[Attachment: Escrow_Release_Authorization_signed.pdf]
[Attachment: Legal_redlines.pdf]

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novacentral.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Escrow hold on Oct invoice — Credit scheduled and DocuSign link

Hi Elena — Lauren from Billing here. Thanks for sending the VAT certificate and signed authorization. We reviewed Legal's redlines; they are acceptable and do not affect the credit processing.

Confirmation and timing:
- Credit amount: $42,300.00 (goodwill/service credit for duplicated ingestion).
- Posting: We will post a standalone credit memo (CRM-2026-1147) to Novacentral's account; the credit will apply against the next invoice cycle and the ledger will show a contra-charge dated 2026-11-27.
- Escrow release: Once the DocuSign release is completed (link below), we will signal your AP team to release funds. Expect the clear entry on your ledger within 24-48 hours after release.

DocuSign release: https://www.docusign.com/records/0X2A-Release-98341 [Please sign by Nov 29 to avoid month-end timing issues]

Accounting reference: Credit Memo CRM-2026-1147 | Finance ticket: FIN-8772

I've attached the credit memo PDF and a brief reconciliation stub for your records. If you prefer the credit to be issued as a refund rather than a credit memo, reply and we'll escalate to Treasury (refunds can take 7–10 business days).

Thanks — Jordan, I'll coordinate the ledger reassignment and notify CS (Marissa) when the credit is applied so they can update the usage dashboard with the corrected attribution.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Billing Lead, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0982
[Attachment: CRM-2026-1147_CreditMemo.pdf]
[Attachment: Reconciliation_Stub_FIN-8772.pdf]
